name: com.erupt.core
description: Extended Reality Universal Programming Toolkit: robot model + IK, environment mirror, interaction router and backends, selection, undo, tier UI, ROS transport, robot setup. Needs com.unity.robotics.ros-tcp-connector and com.unity.robotics.urdf-importer from the parasollab forks; a git package cannot declare git dependencies, so ERUPT offers to add them to the project (ERUPT > Project Setup; see the README).

samples.description: A scene with the ERUPT root, an XR rig with the controller and hand backends, the MoveIt, MTC and demonstration plugins, a floor and a table, and no robot: drag a robot prefab in and press Play.
